inference_scope: Independent profiles; Bayesian comparator conditional on exactly one descending step.
real_sigma: Working assumption in mV, not an instrument-calibrated standard deviation.
chemical_scope: NO3, NH4, Fe, Mn at z <= 90 cm; at least five observed depths; log1p and separate sigmoid fits.
width_definition: Logistic scale w in cm; 10-90 percent transition span is 2*log(9)*w.
